archetypes.name: orchestrator
archetypes.rationale: The diff rewires /design Step 3, Gate B, and Gate C into an automatic multi-round loop with pause/resume sentinel changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the new heuristic Step 3 to Gate B to continuation to Step 3 loop preserves the intended single Gate C approval boundary and flattened round cap. Trace resume, explicit approve, manual rerun, degraded panel, tally-error, and cap-edge flows across SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, design-step3-state.sh, run-step3-review.sh, and plan-review-continuation.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-state
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces cumulative accepted-findings/OOS artifacts and retally env persistence consumed by final summaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether cumulative accepted findings, OOS accepted items, retally outputs, and .step3-* env files stay consistent across normal rounds, main-agent vote fallback, fatal tally errors, and manual Gate C re-entry. Pay special attention to stale accepted artifacts being restored, cleared, filtered, or double-counted by plan-review-loop.sh, persist-retally-step3-env.sh, and render-final-summary.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
